experiment: Reversible black-anchored photographic-contrast encoding of the same source-bound native RAW plate, with controlled Klein and LaMa native reconstruction comparisons.

encoding.implementation: Private Rust qualification example, not a shipping recipe or renderer stage. Shared primaries matrices, signed asinh scale0.18, independent negative/positive range with negative reserve, black0.03, margins0.015, positive gamma2.2. Range+gamma composed in f64, a single f32 output cast. The inverse retains measured negative/HDR information, with no gamut compression or clipping.
encoding.identity_bound: Synthetic f32 identity:3e-6 times max(1,max(abs(RGB))); including65000 scene units, negative channels, black and small shadow signals. Shared durable fp16 codec/graded identity error is separately measured in every RAW bake.
encoding.scope: This changes the combined model-domain contrast/range/gamma protocol. It does not isolate a causal effect of only black level.

initial_test_failure.findings: Composing a float32 signed-log output with another float32 OETF exceeded the HDR identity bound. Replaced with a direct f64 composed curve; the bound stayed3e-6. The neutral-ramp test was corrected to construct linear-sRGB neutrals through the shared inverse primaries matrix: existing four-decimal forward matrix row sums are not exact1. No production matrix changed.

protocol.original: Pinned public Bologna NEF, canonical window2850/1300/1024/1024, orientation1, pre-WB linear calibration plate. Exact original scene/source-anchor bytes and original preserved.
protocol.selection: Same refined intent90546 pixels, accepted coverage95337 and protected302076 for both hole radii8/192. Exact intent/protection/native mask planes match the signed-log controls.
protocol.klein: Same pinned Klein4B8bit learned tensors/runtime, seed3941, four steps, guidance1, background-only instruction, harmonic selected-source erasure, decoder barriers and exact native VAE float inputs.
protocol.lama: Same pinned989 learned tensors and native1024 portable ONNX artifact, direct zero-masked RGB plus mask channel. Eager Torch reference and ONNX CPU runs receive the exact same f32 tensor. No source resize/u8 input quantization. Both encodings/radii are run; no Poisson correction in these LaMa comparisons.
protocol.comparison_scope: Compare each model within its own protocol; different model conditioning and boundary correction mean this is not an isolated causal comparison between model architectures.

findings.klein_radius8: Regenerates a clear replacement person. Boundary correction produced minimum-0.0164926443 and failed the model-domain gate. No clipping, RAW bake or accepted edit.
findings.klein_radius192: Original target no longer visible, but native RAW render retains an obvious target-shaped hazy fill. Fails photographic reconstruction.
findings.lama_signed_log: Both radii leave strong dark/colored artifacts and object-shaped texture mismatches. Fails photographic reconstruction.
findings.lama_contrast: Strong dark color artifacts diminish, but conspicuous object-shaped texture/background mismatch remains at both radii. Visual color improvement only; no photographic or semantic-closure pass.
findings.decision: Improved source contrast does not resolve the reconstruction problem. No encoding, model, mask defaults, accepted asset/XMP or application runtime admitted.

scientific_figure.scope: Actual native RAW crop comparison, not a perceptual color gate or hidden-background truth.

limitations: One public RAW and visually reviewed SAM masks; no independent closure/role truth or verified person-release corpus.
90 known/protected RAW grade image checks and full native float checks establish preservation for these5 valid bakes, not color parity/performance/quality for all consumers or all images.
One rejected Klein boundary correction has no RAW bake; it is not counted in the90 grade checks.
Shared M5 Max128GiB host; uncontrolled timings, no supported16/24/32GiB or p50/p95 qualification.
Current native context cap and large coherent selection strategy, licensing/distribution/runtime integration, all remaining Mac/Web/portable/recovery/performance gates remain.
